title: Chapter 200: Fear Of Insufficient Firepower
content:
Chapter 200: Fear Of Insufficient Firepower

The Zerg dragon group spent some time to destroy all the teams of the bear goblins that were transporting logistical supplies to the city where the army was assembled.

Seeing that it was still early, the Zerg dragon group slaughtered all other ordinary cities near the city where the bear goblin army was assembled.

The cities in the evil god camp were all full of fanatical believers of the evil god. They had completely lost themselves and became machines for producing energy from faith.

Wu Qing asked the Zerg army to attack these people to free them. There was no way to rescue these people.

The Zerg rescued them by parasitism. The puppets rescued were also zombies, which was meaningless.

The Zerg dragon group slaughtered the cities of the bear goblins while resting and recovering. The dragon group, which had fought for a day, insisted on holding on until dark before flying to the Zerg territory.

The Zerg dragon group fought for a day and destroyed countless enemies. None of them lost any personnel, only a few were injured.

This showed the advantages of the Zerg dragon army to the fullest.

Whenever a dragon was seriously injured, a star-level dragon would go to rescue it. There were several dragons that were seriously injured and fell into the enemy's camp. The three-star dragons rushed down and caught them directly.

The injured or even disabled Zerg dragons returned to the Zerg territory and rested for a night. They would be almost recovered tomorrow.

The Zerg had a strong self-healing ability. If there was no lack of energy, it was easy to regenerate broken limbs.

Because of this, the Zerg army did not need medical units. All injuries were self-healing!

60,000 Zerg dragons flew back in an overwhelming manner and fell on the Zerg ground territory that expanded to the mountainous forest area, and recovered on the Zerg fungal carpet hidden under the woods.

...

The Zerg reinforcements in the Naga territory were attacking the last demon castle of the day. After taking down this castle, the Zerg reinforcements would not leave and would stay here overnight.

Nagalon originally disagreed with the Zerg taking such risks, but he was only responsible for leading the way. The Zerg's battle plan was not his responsibility at all, so his suggestions could only be retained.

Under the constant urging of Host No. 3, the Zerg reinforcements are now attacking the sixth Demon Clan Castle!

These Demon Clan Castles are not big, and the demon army stationed there is more than 100,000 or 200,000. The demon army also has a unique style of going out of the city to fight, and they will fight to the death, and they are no match for the Zerg reinforcements at all.

Three castles were taken in the morning, and three castles were taken in the afternoon. With the time for traveling, one day was just enough.

Unsurprisingly, the Zerg reinforcements took down the last Demon Clan Castle before dark, successfully occupied the castle for the night, and saved the consumption of the luck beads.

Knowing that the Zerg reinforcements did not bring anything, Nagalong brought a team of Naga warriors, carrying the luck formation map and enough luck beads, in case the Zerg reinforcements had an accident and needed to spend the night in the wild.

The Naga tribe's arrangement for the Zerg reinforcements was very detailed and in place.

After a day of fighting, the Zerg reinforcements still had more than 300,000 troops, and only lost a small number of Zerg puppies.

…

In the underground world battlefield, the Zerg army withdrew to the Zerg territory before dark.

In today's underground world battlefield, facing the ghouls who were not very active in attacking, in order to obtain as many gas resources as possible, Wu Qing invested a large number of Zerg puppies and took the initiative to attack the ghoul territory at the cost of casualties.

When the Zerg puppies kill the enemy, the system can obtain energy and gas resources at the same time, and the price of the Zerg puppies is only 25 energy resources. Even if it is a one-for-one exchange, it is also a profit of gas resources. This is a very cost-effective deal.

Zerg puppies continuously enter the underground world and launch desperate attacks on countless ghouls in the ghoul territory.

Zerg cockroaches, hydralisks and destroyers follow up to provide remote support.

The large loss of Zerg puppies has rekindled the interest of the ghouls. A large number of ghouls have gathered again and launched a fierce attack on the Zerg army.

In the underground battlefield, the Zerg puppies suffered extremely heavy losses, but their sacrifices brought back a large amount of gas resources to support the upcoming Zerg and Bugbear tribe's ultimate decisive battle.

...

The Zerg's battles in the three battlefields were all over, and Wu Qing and the Queen began to prepare for the ultimate decisive battle with the Bugbear tribe tomorrow.

The Bugbear tribe broke the routine and even sent troops that would not appear in this area. As long as the Zerg won this battle, the Bugbear tribe would basically have no power to fight back in front of the Zerg.

It would be easy for the Zerg to recapture the territory occupied by the Bugbear tribe.

The strange appearance at night also prevented the Bugbear tribe from dispatching troops and transporting logistical materials. Today, the Zerg Dragon Group and Exploding Mosquitoes have already gained an advantage. Tomorrow, the Zerg Dragon Group will continue to maintain the interception strength of today, and the assembled army of the Bugbear tribe will not be strengthened.

In order to prevent any trouble, Wu Qing prepared to take the initiative and fight with the bear goblins tomorrow. He would meet the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department head-on and try to annihilate them in one battle.

To achieve this goal, the Zerg needs to be fully prepared. Today, the Zerg is acquiring resources at all costs in various battlefields, just for this moment.

Wu Qing first asked the Queen to convert all the luck beads brought back from the Naga tribe today into Qi resources.

Naga was very kind. When she learned that the Zerg was going to face a strong enemy, she almost used up the strategic reserve luck beads of several nearby armies.

She knew very well that as long as the Zerg reinforcements did not withdraw, with their combat power, it would not take more than a few days for the demon army to disappear.
